channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Iran launches surprise ballistic missile attack on U.S. forces in the Middle East
item.description: Centcom in a post on X said that the attack originated from Iran, but all missiles were intercepted.

item.title: S&P 500 futures edge higher as oil climbs; investors await Fed rates decision: Live updates
item.description: The Dow is coming off its third straight winning day.

item.title: Why America's super rich have embraced the appeal of British soccer teams
item.description: American investors now control more than half the Premier League. CNBC examines why U.K. soccer clubs have become attractive long-term assets.

item.title: Oil jumps as U.S.-Iran resume strikes after a brief pause
item.description: Oil rose sharply amid renewed tensions in the Middle East after Iran launched an attack on U.S. forces using ballistic missiles.

item.title: Minister apologizes as Korean leveraged ETF investors nurse heavy losses amid chip stock rout
item.description: Korean retail investors have racked up heavy losses from leveraged bets on stocks, following rule changes earlier this year.

item.title: Microsoft short interest hits decade high ahead of Q2 earnings as AI spending raises new questions
item.description: There has been virtually no short covering ahead of Microsoft's earnings report as bearish investors hold their positions.

item.title: Asian technology stocks extend sell-off with SoftBank down 10% as AI plays take a hit
item.description: Chinese internet stocks listed in Hong Kong bucked the broader regional weakness with Tencent, Meituan, Baidu and Kuaishou all trading higher.

item.title: BTS' concerts have been so successful, it's now bad for its own agency Hybe's shares
item.description: Shares of Hybe tanked 16.09% on Tuesday, marking its worst day since June 2022. It then extended losses to tumble as much as 16.31% on Wednesday.

item.title: SK Hynix shares tank as exponential earnings growth fails to satisfy AI-charged expectations
item.description: SK Hynix shares fell as exponential profit and revenue growth failed to meet analysts' lofty expectations for a darling of the artificial intelligence sector.

item.title: Senate confirms Jay Clayton as Trump's director of national intelligence, replacing Pulte
item.description: Bill Pulte had been serving for months as DNI after Tulsi Gabbard resigned the post.

item.title: Apple plans to lease iPhones for $17.99 a month through partnership with Klarna
item.description: Apple is announcing an iPhone lease option weeks after raising iPad and Mac prices due to the global memory shortage.

item.title: Amazon, Meta and Microsoft face skeptical investors this week after Google report sparked sell-off
item.description: Alphabet's free cash flow has turned negative, and the company lifted its capital spending forecast. Slower-growing cloud rivals report this week.

item.title: U.S. and Korean tech stocks are now tightly linked — and that could be a worry for investors
item.description: The 60-day correlation between the Kospi and Nasdaq 100 recently climbed to about 0.50, its highest level since 2021, according to data provided by Rayliant.

item.title: Morgan Stanley says buy these quality stocks. They also pay dividends
item.description: Chief U.S. equity strategist Mike Wilson says the market rotation bodes well for quality stocks. The firm is overweight on these names.

item.title: Elon Musk's xAI sues Minnesota over law to ban 'nudify' apps
item.description: Elon Musk's xAI, now owned by SpaceX, is challenging a law that would ban so-called nudify apps in Minnesota

item.title: Trump, DOJ ask Supreme Court to toss $83.3M defamation award to E. Jean Carroll
item.description: The Supreme Court recently rejected President Donald Trump's bid to hear his appeal of another $5 million verdict in favor of Carroll.

item.title: Ford raises guidance after Q2 earnings beat, says F-Series recovery is on track
item.description: Ford cited operational improvements, resilient vehicle pricing and a high sales mix of profitable products for its performance and the improved guidance.

item.title: Apple touches $5 trillion market cap for first time
item.description: The jockeying between Apple and Nvidia reflects a debate about the future of AI that has preoccupied investors this summer.

item.title: Elon Musk stocks take $1.5 trillion hit with fresh test in SpaceX lockup ahead
item.description: It's been a rough month for Elon Musk, if there is such a thing for the world's richest man.

item.title: Kentucky Gov. Beshear calls on Mitch McConnell to prove he can serve or resign
item.description: McConnell’s prolonged absence could complicate the GOP’s narrow Senate majority and trigger an untested Kentucky vacancy process.

item.title: The Dow jumps as the AI trade wobbles. Plus, a portfolio name goes on the M&A hunt
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: The average car loan term is nearly 6 years — here's what that means for your wallet
item.description: A longer car loan term means lower monthly payments now, but a higher total cost over time.

item.title: Blurred front lines: Trump meets Zelenskyy as Ukraine, Iran wars collide
item.description: Trump and Zelenskyy meet as the U.S war against Iran and Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine have threatened to overlap in recent days.

item.title: SpaceX, Blue Origin could get quicker launch approval under FAA move to waive environmental rules
item.description: "America won the first Space Race, and we can do it again — but only if we get government red tape out of the way," Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said.

item.title: U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve faces stress as emergency releases strain old infrastructure
item.description: The reserve has an authorized storage capacity of 714 million barrels, according to the Department of Energy.

item.title: Senate sets up votes to sanction Russia for Ukraine war
item.description: The sanctions target Russian officials, oligarchs, their family members, foreign persons, Russian banks and financial institutions and the Russian shadow fleet.

item.title: 44 states are aligned on one thing in their fight against prediction markets. It's about sports wagering
item.description: The letter is part of the commission’s public comment period for the first draft of its proposed rule on regulating prediction markets.

item.title: Trump: New tariffs 'doing the same thing' as the ones struck down by Supreme Court
item.description: President Trump dismissed fears his tariffs could hurt the economy — especially as affordability concerns have become a key issue of the 2026 midterm elections.

item.title: Shein says it's under investigation by the Federal Trade Commission as it prepares for Hong Kong IPO
item.description: Shein disclosed the FTC is investigating its U.S. business, but the nature of the probe is unclear.

item.title: Trump administration to ban new Chinese robots and inverters, protecting U.S. AI
item.description: The Trump administration on Tuesday plans to unveil new bans that target imports of ⁠the latest ‌Chinese robots and power inverters, seeking ⁠to protect the U.S. AI buildout from national security threats and reshore key industries slated for explosive growth, U.S. officials said.
